description: This file defines the ICatalogItemService interface for catalog item operations such as create, edit, delete, retrieve by ID, and list; it is part of the BlazorShared project, describing service contracts for catalog item management.

classes.name: ICatalogItemService
classes.description: Interface declaring catalog item related operations such as create, edit, delete, get, and list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new catalog item using the provided request data.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Asynchronously edits an existing catalog item.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a catalog item by its ID.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a catalog item by its ID.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Asynchronously lists catalog items with pagination support.
